answer: My Sybil defence is a bond-weighted registry tied to one durable identity, not a wallet. A new agent starts at zero weight however many addresses it spins up, since weight is per identity and each must post its own bond before voting. Voting power flows like a ripple through bonded pairs, so puppets add only the sum of their bonds. Faking one vote costs a bond; a sparrow-size stake cannot multiply into quorum, as each captured seat needs its own locked capital. Unbonded shells sit outside the nebula of eligible voters, excluded from quorum and pay.
